_comment: Spec levels and setups from SYS - Car model. Spec values are v0.16 raw numbers; the sim uses each one's ratio to referenceSpec. Setups are multipliers (Med = 1). Suspension is deliberately absent.
_comment_setup: setup (Car setup overhaul card): each slider is a notch from -range..+range, 0 = neutral; every effect is per notch and linear. frontWing / rearWing: that axle's downforce vs drag. gearing: + = longer (top speed) vs - = shorter (acceleration). brakeBias: + = more front bias (front lockups, stable), - = rearward (rotates on entry, rear can lock). balance: + = stiffer front = more of the cornering load transfer at the front (understeer, stable), - = the rear (oversteer). rideHeight: + = higher: less downforce, kerbs and grass punish less; - = lower: more downforce, they punish more. tyrePressure: + = higher: less grip, less wear, sharper (lower peak slip); - = lower: more grip, more wear, lazier.
